title: <class 'TypeError'>: Object of type 'DataFrame' is not JSON serializable
question:
I have a dataframe with 3 columns : date, week and yearweek. I want to extract the first and the last day of the week. Here is my dataset :

+----------+-------+------------+
|      date|   week|    yearweek|
+----------+-------+------------+
|2025-01-26|      5|     2025S05|  
|2025-01-27|      5|     2025S05|      
|2025-01-28|      5|     2025S05|        
|2025-01-29|      5|     2025S05|     
|2025-01-30|      5|     2025S05|     
|2025-01-31|      5|     2025S05|       
|2025-02-01|      5|     2025S05|       
+----------+-------+------------+

I need this result, that's why I need a list :

['2025-01-26',
 '2025-01-27',
 '2025-01-28',
 '2025-01-29',
 '2025-01-30',
 '2025-01-31',
 '2025-02-01']

I tried to do this :

 list_date_week = list(     
    df.select(col('date')).toPandas()['date'] 
)  
min_date=min(list_date_week) 
max_date=max(list_date_week)

But I have this error :

<class 'TypeError'>: Object of type 'DataFrame' is not JSON serializable

I tried another solution to convert my Pyspark column to List.

When I try this 2 codes I have this error :

list_date_week = df.select("date").rdd.flatMap(lambda x: x).collect()

list_date_week = df.rdd.map(lambda x: x[0]).collect()

AttributeError: 'SparkSession' object has no attribute 'serializer'

df is a dataframe and list_date_week is a list. I'm beginner in Pyspark, how can I convert my dataframe to list without error in Pyspark ?
answer:
You can just group by the yearweek column and then calculate the minimum and maximum dates for each group.

result = df.groupBy("yearweek").agg(
    min("date").alias("first_day_of_week"),
    max("date").alias("last_day_of_week")
)
